server.name: agents/github
server.title: GitHub
server.description: Issues, pull requests and Actions: the official GitHub MCP server's tools, and events

server.name: agents/linear
server.title: Linear
server.description: Linear issues: a page of open issues with Start Agent, and events when one is opened, labelled, commented on or closed

server.name: agents/jira
server.title: Jira
server.description: Jira issues on Jira Cloud or Data Center: a page of open issues with Start Agent, and events when one is opened, labelled, commented on or assigned to you

server.name: agents/gitlab
server.title: GitLab
server.description: Merge requests, pipelines and issues on gitlab.com or a self-managed GitLab: their pages, tools to read them and comment, and events

server.name: agents/email
server.title: Email
server.description: One mailbox over IMAP: an event when mail comes, a Mail page, and tools to list, search and read it, mark it read and move it. It never sends mail

server.name: agents/slack
server.title: Slack
server.description: One Slack workspace, as your Slack app's bot over Socket Mode: events when a message comes or a question is answered, and tools to list channels, read messages, send a message and ask a question with buttons

secrets.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: The Slack app's Bot User OAuth Token, xoxb-…

secrets.name: SLACK_APP_TOKEN
secrets.description: An app-level token with connections:write, xapp-…

server.name: agents/googlechat
server.title: Google Chat
server.description: A Google Chat app: an event when a person writes to it or answers its question, and tools to post in its spaces and ask a question with a button per option

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CHAT_CREDENTIALS
secrets.description: The Chat app's service account key: its JSON, or the path of its file

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CHAT_SUBSCRIPTION
secrets.description: The app's Pub/Sub subscription: projects/<project>/subscriptions/<name>, or a name in the key's project; agents-chat when left out

server.name: agents/whatsapp
server.title: WhatsApp
server.description: A WhatsApp Business number on Meta's Cloud API: an event when a person writes to it or answers its question, and tools to send a message, ask a question with buttons and send an approved template

secrets.name: WHATSAPP_TOKEN
secrets.description: A system user's access token with whatsapp_business_messaging

secrets.name: WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
secrets.description: The business number's id, from the app's WhatsApp ▸ API Setup page

secrets.name: WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET
secrets.description: The Meta app's secret, which signs each webhook call

secrets.name: WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN
secrets.description: A word of your own, which you also give Meta when you set up the webhook

secrets.name: WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_ADDR
secrets.description: Where the webhook listens, behind your tunnel or reverse proxy; 127.0.0.1:8797 when left out

server.name: io.github.getsentry/sentry-mcp
server.title: Sentry
server.description: Sentry's official MCP server (getsentry/sentry-mcp): search issues and events, read stack traces, releases and traces, and ask Seer for a fix; sign in to Sentry

server.name: agents/sentry
server.title: Sentry events
server.description: One Sentry organization's issues as events: a new issue, and a resolved issue that came back, each with its project, level and release. Add Sentry for the tools

secrets.name: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
secrets.description: A personal auth token with event:read, org:read and project:read, sntryu_…

secrets.name: SENTRY_ORG
secrets.description: The organization's slug, as in acme.sentry.io

secrets.name: SENTRY_URL
secrets.description: Sentry's address: https://sentry.io when left out, https://de.sentry.io for the EU, or your own Sentry

server.name: com.betterstack/mcp
server.title: Better Stack
server.description: Better Stack's official MCP server: monitors, incidents, on-call and status pages, with logs and metrics; sign in to Better Stack

server.name: agents/betterstack
server.title: Better Stack events
server.description: One Better Stack team's incidents as events: a monitor behind a status page that failed, and one that works again. Add Better Stack for the tools

secrets.name: BETTERSTACK_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: An Uptime API token: a team's, or a global one with BETTERSTACK_TEAM

secrets.name: BETTERSTACK_TEAM
secrets.description: The team's name, for a global API token; leave it out for a team's own

secrets.name: BETTERSTACK_URL
secrets.description: Better Stack's incidents API: https://incidents.betterstack.com when left out

server.name: agents/forgejo
server.title: Forgejo
server.description: Pull requests, checks and issues on Codeberg or your own Forgejo or Gitea: their pages, tools to read them and comment, and events

server.name: agents/bitbucket
server.title: Bitbucket
server.description: Pull requests, checks and issues on Bitbucket Cloud: their pages, tools to read them and comment, and events

server.name: agents/azuredevops
server.title: Azure DevOps
server.description: Pull requests and Azure Pipelines builds on Azure DevOps Repos or your own Azure DevOps Server: their pages, tools to read them and comment, and events

server.name: agents/azureboards
server.title: Azure Boards
server.description: Work items on Azure Boards or your own Azure DevOps Server, as a tracker: a page of open work items with Start Agent, tools to read them and comment, and events when one is opened, tagged, commented on, closed or assigned to you

secrets.name: AZURE_BOARDS_PROJECT
secrets.description: The project, as organization/project; left out, the folder's Azure Repos remote's
